Beetlejuice: Horrific Hijinx from the Neitherworld!

Beetlejuice: Horrific Hijinx from the Neitherworld! is a video game created by Rare and published by Acclaim Entertainment for the Nintendo Game Boy in 1992. It is based on the Beetlejuice animated television series.

The game begins with the player taking control of Beetlejuice as he attempts to get rid of all the ghosts that he invited into Lydia Deetz's house (where she lives with her father and step-mother). He must rescue Lydia from the evil Astoroth. Using bio-exorcist magic, players must defeat undead creatures through the cemetery and inside the Neitherworld.

Beetlejuice: Horrific Hijinx from the Neitherworld! es un videojuego creado por Rare y publicado por Acclaim Entertainment para Game Boy en 1992. Está basado en la serie animada de televisión de Beetlejuice.

El juego comienza con el jugador tomando el control de Beetlejuice mientras intenta deshacerse de todos los fantasmas que invitó a la casa de Lydia Deetz (donde ella vive con su padre y su madrastra). Debe rescatar a Lydia del malvado Astoroth. Usando magia bioexorcista, los jugadores deben derrotar a criaturas no muertas por el cementerio y dentro del Neitherworld.

In the game you control Beetlejuice through various side-scrolling and overhead view levels in an effort to scare the yuppie Deetz family and friends that have taken over the house. You stomp on cockroaches in order to gain points that you used to buy various scare tactics that you use to defeat various enemies and bosses. Although the initial levels of the game are based upon the film, with Beetlejuice venturing through the Maitland House to find and scare away Otho, the later levels are original and involve Beetlejuice fighting mythical creatures in such locations as a sewer system and the afterlife.

En el juego controlas a Beetlejuice a través de diversos niveles de desplazamiento lateral y vista cenital, con el objetivo de asustar a la familia Deetz, de tipo yuppie, y a sus amigos, que se han apoderado de la casa. Pisas cucarachas para obtener puntos, con los que compras diversas tácticas de miedo que usas para derrotar a distintos enemigos y jefes. Aunque los primeros niveles se basan en la película, en la que Beetlejuice recorre la Maitland House para encontrar y ahuyentar a Otho, los niveles posteriores son originales e implican que Beetlejuice luche contra criaturas mitológicas en lugares como un sistema de alcantarillado y el más allá.
